messages:
lucy: Auditor requested evidence that OPA RBAC change resulted in decision logs and related KMS activity. I’m gathering a concise package: PR + commit, deployed bundle.json, decision-log slice, KMS audit entries, and a signed manifest.
owen: What time window should we grab?
lucy: Use deploy window 2025-03-18T09:12:00Z..2025-03-18T09:40:00Z with +/-5m padding.
auditor_claire: Sampling is fine if you include chain-of-custody: CI id, PR approver, cosign signature, and checksums. Also map artifacts to SOC2 CC6 / ISO A.9 controls.
samir: FYI a low-severity vuln CVE-2025-1234 is in our inventory; call it out but it’s unrelated to this change.
lucy: Extraction commands I’ll run (and include): gcloud logging read for OPA decision logs and KMS events, jq filter to pull decision_context.request_id, sha256sum for manifest, cosign sign-blob, upload to s3 and presign.
owen: I located one correlated request: request_id=abcd-1234 at 2025-03-18T09:20:11Z which exercised the new allow rule. Marked it as example 1.
lucy: Package contents: PR_link.txt, bundle.json, opa_slice.ndjson, kms_events.ndjson, mapping.md, manifest.json, manifest.sig, manifest.sha256, verify_instructions.txt. Will upload and post presigned links by EOD PST.
auditor_claire: Please include verify commands and a short note showing how to correlate request_id between opa_slice and kms_events (logName/insertId). Thank you.
security-bot: Reminder to redact any sensitive fields per log policy; KMS logs only include metadata.
lucy: Will confirm redaction and then upload. Ping me if anything blocks.
